Test Case: Load the Source panel fresh
Expected Result: "From a stack" tab is active by default; stack controls visible, file controls hidden (FR-1.1)

Test Case: After entering a Region on the stack tab, switch to "From a file" then back to "From a stack"
Expected Result: Target mode's controls shown and the other's hidden; previously entered stack data is retained within the session (FR-1.2, EC-8)

Test Case: Enter data in stack mode, switch to file mode, trigger the file action
Expected Result: Only the active (file) mode drives the action; hidden stack data is not submitted (EC-8)

Test Case: Observe the Source header while state is idle, running, and ready
Expected Result: Header shows source name + meta line; status badge (pill) reflects the current source state (FR-1.3)

Test Case: Open the stack tab with no selections made
Expected Result: Region dropdown enabled; Organization and Stack disabled/empty; primary action disabled (AC-1.1)

Test Case: Select a Region, then open the Organization dropdown
Expected Result: Organization lists the orgs available for that region (AC-1.2, FR-2.2)

Test Case: Select an Organization
Expected Result: Stack dropdown becomes enabled and lists the stacks in that org (AC-1.2, FR-2.3)

Test Case: Attempt to use the Stack dropdown before selecting an Organization
Expected Result: Stack remains disabled/empty until its upstream Organization is chosen (FR-2.4)

Test Case: Select a Stack and observe the Branch row
Expected Result: Branch row shows the default branch main (FR-2.5, A-2)

Test Case: Click "Change" on the Branch row and select a non-default branch
Expected Result: Branch row updates to the chosen branch; the subsequent export request uses that branch (AC-1.5, UC-1b)

Test Case: With Region+Org+Stack selected and scope "Whole stack", click the primary action
Expected Result: Button enters loading state; a scoped export request is sent for the selected stack + branch; on success the content graph and five stat tiles render (AC-1.3)

Test Case: Observe the scope radio on the stack tab
Expected Result: "Whole stack" is selected by default (FR-2.6)

Test Case: Switch scope to "Specific module" and open the module dropdown
Expected Result: Modules are listed each with a numeric count; the primary action stays disabled until at least one module is checked (AC-1.6, FR-2.7)

Test Case: Check exactly two modules and start the export
Expected Result: The export request is scoped to exactly those two modules (AC-1.7)

Test Case: Leave any one of Region/Org/Stack unset and inspect the primary action
Expected Result: Primary action remains disabled; no export request is sent (FR-2.9, EC-2)

Test Case: Complete a whole-stack export
Expected Result: The source selection (region, org, stack, branch, scope=whole) is persisted to the project (AC-1.4, FR-5.2)

Test Case: Switch to the "From a file" tab with no file selected
Expected Result: Dropzone "Drop a migration file or click to browse" is shown; the extract action is disabled (AC-2.1)

Test Case: Choose a valid .zip Contentstack export bundle
Expected Result: A file card shows the file name, size, and "selected just now"; a remove (x) control is present (AC-2.2, FR-3.2)

Test Case: With a valid bundle selected, trigger extract/validate
Expected Result: Actions lock; on success a "What's in this file" manifest lists each module with a count, plus a file meta line (AC-2.3, FR-3.3)

Test Case: After validation, observe the import scope radio
Expected Result: "Everything in this file" is selected by default (FR-3.4)

Test Case: With scope "Everything in this file", proceed
Expected Result: Content graph renders from the extracted file; the file source selection is persisted (AC-2.4)

Test Case: Switch scope to "Specific modules" and open the dropdown
Expected Result: The file's modules are listed each with a count (FR-3.5)

Test Case: Check a module that depends on another (entries requiring content types/assets)
Expected Result: The required module is auto-checked and labeled "required by entries" (AC-2.5, FR-3.6)

Test Case: Attempt to uncheck a "required by entries" module while a dependent module is still checked
Expected Result: The uncheck is prevented (AC-2.5, FR-3.6)

Test Case: Select a file (not yet validated) and click the remove (x) control
Expected Result: The file is cleared and the dropzone is shown again (AC-2.6)

Test Case: After validation, click "Upload another file"
Expected Result: The current bundle and manifest are discarded and the dropzone is shown (AC-2.7, UC-2b)

Test Case: Observe both file actions while an extract is in progress
Expected Result: "Upload another file" and the extract action are both disabled (fileActionsLocked) (FR-3.7)

Test Case: Upload a non-Contentstack / corrupt / missing-manifest zip and validate
Expected Result: Validation fails; a user-visible error is shown; no manifest renders (EC-3, FR-3.8)

Test Case: Attempt to upload a bundle larger than 100 MB
Expected Result: Upload is rejected with a user-visible size-limit message (EC-4, FR-3.9)

Test Case: Choose "Specific modules" with no module checked
Expected Result: Extract/proceed stays disabled; no request is sent (EC-2)

Test Case: Open the Source panel before any read completes
Expected Result: Graph area shows the text "Relationship between content types will be shown here once the export completes." (AC-3.1, FR-4.1)

Test Case: After a successful export/extract with known counts
Expected Result: The five tiles (Content types, Assets, Entries, Global fields, References) show counts equal to the extract result (AC-3.2, FR-4.2, G-4)

Test Case: After a successful read
Expected Result: Content-type nodes render in dependency order top-to-bottom with reference edges between related types (FR-4.3)

Test Case: Click zoom-in, zoom-out, reset, and drag the canvas
Expected Result: Graph scales and pans accordingly; reset returns it to the default view (AC-3.3, FR-4.4)

Test Case: Export/extract an empty stack or file
Expected Result: Graph shows a valid zero-state (all five counts = 0) rather than erroring (EC-7)

Test Case: With a persisted source, reload the Content Map & Audit step
Expected Result: The correct tab, region/org/stack/branch or file reference, scope, and selected modules are restored to their persisted values (AC-4.1, UC-4, NFR-5)

Test Case: Return to the step after a completed export
Expected Result: The persisted graph summary (nodes/edges + five counts) is restored/shown (UC-4; TRD DM-2 persist graph summary)

Test Case: POST /v3/source/export with a valid stack selection
Expected Result: Responds 202 with { jobId } (API-1, FR-5.5)

Test Case: GET /v3/source/export/:jobId for a running job
Expected Result: Returns { status } of queued/running/succeeded/failed (with progress when running) (API-2)

Test Case: POST /v3/source/upload (multipart) with a valid .zip
Expected Result: Responds 200 with { sourceId, fileName, sizeBytes, manifest[] } (API-3)

Test Case: POST /v3/source/upload with an invalid/corrupt bundle
Expected Result: Responds 400 (not-a-valid-bundle) (API-3, EC-3)

Test Case: POST /v3/source/upload with a file > 100 MB
Expected Result: Responds 413 (too-large) (API-3, EC-4)

Test Case: GET /v3/source/regions, /orgs?region=, /stacks?orgId=, /branches?stackApiKey=
Expected Result: Each returns the expected list shape for the supplied upstream parameter (API-4, FR-5.3)

Test Case: GET /v3/source/modules for a stack (orgId/stackApiKey/branch) or file (sourceId)
Expected Result: Returns { modules:[{name,count,forced?,requiredBy?}] } (API-5, FR-5.4)

Test Case: GET /v3/source/:projectId/graph after a successful read
Expected Result: Returns { counts, nodes, edges } (API-6, FR-5.6)

Test Case: GET /v3/source/:projectId/graph before any export completed
Expected Result: Responds 404 (no-graph-yet) (API-6)

Test Case: PUT /v3/org/:orgId/project/:projectId/source with a selection sub-object
Expected Result: Responds 200 with { source }; the persisted selection is retrievable (API-7, FR-5.2)

Test Case: Call any /v3/source endpoint without a valid app_token header
Expected Result: Responds 401 Unauthorized; request is rejected (NFR-3, EC-5)

Test Case: Perform a list/export with an expired session or insufficient scope
Expected Result: 401/403 returned and the UI surfaces an auth/permission error rather than failing silently (EC-5)

Test Case: Trigger an export using a stack management token, then inspect server logs
Expected Result: Source credentials/tokens do not appear in logs (NFR-3)

Test Case: Start, succeed, and fail an export/extract
Expected Result: Start, success, and failure are logged with project/stack identifiers and no secrets (NFR-7)

Test Case: Inspect the graph zoom-in/zoom-out/reset buttons
Expected Result: Each button exposes an aria-label ("Zoom in" / "Zoom out" / "Reset view") (NFR-4)

Test Case: Operate the dropdowns, scope radios, and module checkboxes using the keyboard only
Expected Result: All controls are reachable and operable via keyboard (NFR-4)

Test Case: Use an account with no accessible orgs (or select an org with no stacks)
Expected Result: Organization/Stack dropdown shows an empty state; primary action stays disabled; a message explains none are available (EC-1)

Test Case: Simulate a network failure or timeout during export/extract
Expected Result: Loading/locked state ends; an error is shown; the selection is preserved so the user can retry without re-entering it (EC-6)

Test Case: Observe the UI during a long export/extract
Expected Result: UI reflects the loading/locked state and never appears frozen (NFR-2)

Test Case: Load a source with a large number of content types/references
Expected Result: Graph remains pannable/zoomable and the UI does not freeze (EC-10 - exact node/reference ceiling is a gap)

Test Case: Measure p95 latency of the regions/orgs/stacks/branches list endpoints
Expected Result: p95 < 800 ms (provisional per NFR-1 SHOULD; threshold not finalized - see gaps)
